caption:
SkinTech — a lip-care applicator, designed from the brief up.

A product/packaging study: research the lip-care shelf, find the weak spot (everyone ships a fiddly glass jar), and propose something better — a metal-capped, glass-barrelled roll-on. A locking cap, a roller ball for clean application, and a translucent tube so you can see what's left. From market study and sketches to a final render.

Product & packaging design — Anirudh Kapoor. A·46.
